seedCheck: All twelve seeds were checked disjoint from all existing top-level experiment manifests before these validation manifests were created.
failureGate: Every cap, watchdog, illegal decision or crash is retained as failure; zero failures required for further consideration.
analysis: Report paired whole-seed bootstrap intervals per stratum, with failures in denominators. No pooled win-rate ranking, multiplicity-adjusted claim or in-batch tuning.
decision: A positive primary point difference with no negative secondary point differences supports further investigation only. A nonpositive primary difference does not confirm the training improvement. No automatic gameplay promotion, difficulty claim or global optimality claim.
remainingGates: Independent final test design and adequate sample size
Worker integration and private human playtests
registrationNote: Run setup was locked before launch. The analysis/decision plan was recorded while execution was in progress, before inspecting win outcomes; this is not an external preregistration.
